name: Chicken, Pesto & Mozzarella Panini
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup roasted red peppers (jarred, drained, and sliced)

recipeInstructions.text: Spread pesto on one side of each slice of ciabatta.
On two of the slices, layer shredded chicken, fresh mozzarella, roasted red peppers, and arugula. Top with the other slices, pesto side down.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium. Cook the panini 3-4 minutes per side, pressing with a heavy pan, until the cheese melts and the bread is golden.
Slice diagonally and drizzle with balsamic glaze.
For more flavor, season the chicken with a pinch of smoked paprika or garlic powder before assembling.
